title: Approval-triggered reruns: pull_request_review gate in trigger-rerun.yml hands off to a workflow_run worker in rerun.yml
answers: Where is the logic that reruns failed checks after a PR is approved?
Who is allowed to approve a PR and cause reruns (author association and bot allowlist)?
Why is there a separate trigger workflow instead of rerunning directly on pull_request_review?
Which concurrency setting controls overlapping approval reruns?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/trigger-rerun.yml:approved is the PR approval gate. It fires on pull_request_review submitted and only passes when the review state is approved and the reviewer is OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR, or a bot in the mlflow-app[bot] / nailaopus[bot] allowlist. .github/workflows/rerun.yml:rerun is the worker that runs on workflow_run completion and reads the PR head SHA from the event.
Rule: Keep the two-step split. The approval job is a no-data trigger because a workflow_run trigger needs a completed run to react to; the worker must reread the head SHA from `github.event.workflow_run.head_sha` and not receive data from the trigger. The worker only runs when `workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'`. Its concurrency group is keyed by `workflow_run.head_branch` with cancel-in-progress true, while the trigger's group is keyed by `github.ref` with cancel-in-progress false.
Constraints: The pull_request_review form is used because it works for approvals on forks (see the linked StackOverflow reference in the trigger file's header). Changes to who may approve belong in the `if:` of trigger-rerun.yml; changes to which runs get rerun belong in the jq pipeline of rerun.yml.
applies: Scope: the approval-triggered rerun path in .github/workflows/trigger-rerun.yml and .github/workflows/rerun.yml; not the Protect gate or retry workflow.
says: Which team roles and automation bots are permitted to trigger check reruns on approval?
Allow designated GitHub bot accounts to trigger automated test reruns upon pull request approval.
Cancel older in-progress rerun jobs when a pull request branch receives a new approval.
Ensure automated CI reruns execute properly when pull requests originate from forked repositories.
Reviews from external contributors should not trigger automated test reruns on pull requests.
search: Approval-triggered CI reruns use a two-step architecture where `.github/workflows/trigger-rerun.yml:approved` gates approvals and triggers `.github/workflows/rerun.yml:rerun` via a `workflow_run` event. The trigger checks for approved reviews by repository OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR, or bots in `mlflow-app[bot]` and `nailaopus[bot]`, passing execution to the worker when conclusion is success. The worker reads `github.event.workflow_run.head_sha`, cancels in-progress jobs per head branch, while the trigger uses `github.ref` without cancellation to reliably support approvals on forked repositories.
